digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter refactoring and shared layer organization
propositions: jira_fields.py, identity.py, and probe.py contain Jira-family-general logic that must be extracted from adapters/jira/ into a new adapters/jira_family/ shared layer with public names

jira_fields.py must split by symbol: pure sanitizers and maps move outright, while _sanitize_description and _sanitize_comment move contract-parameterized with injected codec and limit dependencies to avoid inverting the dependency direction

probe.py's pure classifier relocates with resolved-status set as a required keyword-only parameter instead of reading module-level RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, while probe() and _resolve_env() remain in adapters/jira as Cloud-specific transport
the unified status and priority maps adopt the outbound_fields.py definition (including deleted->Done), consolidating three drifted copies into one canonical definition site in jira_family

location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) stay in place and share the jira_family symbols by dependency inversion; all imports into them must be absolute, never relative, to survive spec_from_file_location synthetic-module loading with no package context

every internal importer and mock.patch target must be re-pointed to jira_family paths with no re-export shims left at old paths, and acli*.py must change only in import lines while retaining byte-identical logic and __all__ through aliased imports
